parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the bill query, expressed as a second-level UNIX timestamp. The value must be later than StartTime.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
Specifies the time interval for querying data. This is an enumeration value. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, ERR_PARAMS_INVALID is returned. Valid values:

- 3600: queries hourly data.
- 86400: queries daily data.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language. This is an enumeration value.
Default value: zh.
Valid value: en.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the bill query, expressed as a second-level UNIX timestamp.
